trial_court: Senior Civil Judge-1, Palamau at Daltonganj, Succession Case No. 14 of 2008

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sushma Toppo, wife of late Nirmal Toppo and Deepak Toppo, son of late Nirmal Toppo
parties.respondent_defendant: Teressa Khalkho, wife of late Nirmal Toppo, Atul Kumar Toppo, son of late Nirmal Toppo, Amit Kumar Toppo, son of late Nirmal Toppo and Alka Rani Toppo, daughter of late Nirmal Toppo

facts_of_case: Nirmal Toppo was IIIrd Grade employee of Civil Courts Palamau and member of Scheduled Tribes by Caste Oraon. He was married to Teressa Khalkho but she used to lead vagrant life and habitual to run away from her in-laws place. The appellants prayed for issuing succession certificate, fixation of monthly pension and appointment in service on compensatory ground.

legal_principles.principle: A person claiming to be the legal heir of a deceased person must establish their legal right to succeed.
legal_principles.held: There is no legal impediment to grant succession certificate in favour of the appellants because no any WILL executed by the deceased for estate left by him and no any application has been made to any Court for Letters of Administration.

legal_principles.principle: A person claiming to be the spouse of a deceased person must establish their legal marriage through valid documents.
legal_principles.held: Appellant No.1 Sushma Toppo is not legally wedded wife of deceased Nirmal Toppo, therefore neither she nor her sons and daughter are entitled to get any share as successor or legal heir of deceased Nirmal Toppo.

outcome.final_order: The prayer of the appellants was dismissed by the trial court and the same is upheld by this court.
